issues.legal_issue: A land-ceiling determination cannot rest on an uncontested assumption in a notice when possession is disputed and the authorities have made no clear finding on that issue.
material_facts: The landowner’s continued cultivating possession when the ceiling law came into force was disputed.
The claim was that the landowner and a family member had separated their holdings and that the landowner’s grandsons had purchased land from him earlier.
The lower authorities relied on a notice stating that the landowner remained in possession but did not make a clear finding on the disputed possession claims.
issues.conclusion: The appeal was allowed and the matter was remitted to the prescribed authority to determine whether the original owner remained in cultivating possession when the ceiling law came into force and whether the other grandsons were in separate cultivating possession of the lands claimed by them.
issues.legal_principle: In a land-ceiling proceeding, the authority must determine the material question of cultivating possession at the time the ceiling law came into force, including the parties’ disputed contentions; a statement in a notice under Section 10(2) of the applicable Ceiling Act does not substitute for a clear finding where possession is contested. No earlier cases are relied on.

rule.if: ceiling_case_appeal and possession_contested and lower_authorities_relied_on_notice and no_clear_possession_finding

predicates.ceiling_case_appeal: The matter is an appeal in a proceeding determining whether land is subject to a ceiling.
predicates.possession_contested: The affected parties dispute who held cultivating possession of the land at the legally relevant time.
predicates.lower_authorities_relied_on_notice: The lower authorities relied on a notice stating who was in possession.
predicates.no_clear_possession_finding: The lower authorities made no clear finding resolving the disputed possession claims.

issues.definition: When a ceiling appeal involves disputed cultivating possession, the lower authorities rely on a notice, and they make no clear finding, the matter is remitted for a determination of possession.

issues.legal_issue: A factual finding resolving a challenge concerning a grove is not disturbed when the reviewing court finds no basis for interference.
material_facts: The grove issue had already been concluded by findings of fact.
issues.conclusion: The court declined to interfere with the findings concerning the grove.
issues.legal_principle: The court treated the grove issue as concluded by factual findings and stated that it did not call for interference; no statutory provision or earlier case was cited for this point.

predicates.ceiling_case_appeal: The matter is an appeal in a proceeding determining whether land is subject to a ceiling.
predicates.grove_issue_resolved_by_fact_findings: The issue concerning a grove has already been resolved by findings of fact.

issues.definition: When an issue concerning a grove in a ceiling appeal has already been resolved by factual findings, those findings are left undisturbed.
